description: Public restore graph mutations checked by successful loading, named object/volume counts, analytic volumes, and world-space placement. Both marked and unmarked inputs have valid identifiers. Crashes, exceptions, timeouts and build errors are not assertion kills.

mutants.description: Keeping serialized wrapper id 123 leaves the marked root reference17 unresolved; named first-object volume count and geometry must catch missing mesh even if load succeeds.
Leaving child id1 after moving its mesh to65553 loses the marked first-object volume; the count and analytic geometry oracles must detect it.
Disabling the part marker bypasses UUID normalization, so the marked graph loses its first-object mesh. The marker-free control remains a valid graph using wrapper123.
